assembly_acta_desc: This is the official record of the assembly.
assembly_acta_edit_desc: You can add additional details but the decisions are already registered.
assembly_acta_readonly_desc: Read-only. If you have permission, you can edit with the button below.
assembly_approval_config_desc2: each type of community decision. Each proposal type can have a different approval method. For example, you can configure product approval to be decided quickly by the Board of Directors, but product removal to require a full Assembly vote with 2/3 majority.
assembly_approval_method_help: Defines who makes the decision for this proposal type. Each method has different speed and security characteristics.
assembly_attendance_desc: Mark the members present at the assembly. Only marked members will be able to vote in this in-person session.
assembly_attendance_window_desc: How early attendance can be registered before the scheduled time.
assembly_authorized_any_desc: Any of the authorized people below can approve this change alone. They do not all need to sign, one authorized person acting is enough.
assembly_authorized_person_help: Select the person who will have authority to approve or reject this proposal type alone, without a vote.
assembly_authorized_persons_help: List of authorized people. ANY of them can approve alone. They do not all need to sign. Different from multi-signature where ALL must sign.
assembly_auto_convocation_desc: Configure how often the ordinary assembly is convened. When an assembly closes, the next one is scheduled automatically.
assembly_auto_convocation_note: These are basic settings. They do not require assembly approval. They can be edited by: administrator, board of directors, director or secretary.
assembly_board_config_note: The board of directors is configured in the section
assembly_board_desc: The board of directors can make multi-signature decisions without a full assembly. Each position has specific responsibilities.
assembly_board_percentage_help: Percentage of board votes in favor needed to approve. 50% = simple majority of the board.
assembly_board_percentage_hint: 50 = simple majority of the board. 66.67 = 2/3 of the board.
assembly_board_quorum_help_desc: Board quorum is the minimum percentage of board members who must be present for the meeting to be valid.
assembly_board_quorum_help_desc2: Since the board has fewer members (e.g.: 5-7), quorum is over that number, not over all node members.
assembly_board_quorum_note: changing the board quorum is an Assembly decision, not the board's.
assembly_board_sessions_desc: Board of Directors sessions are more frequent and for operational decisions. Only board members can vote. Quorum is lower.
assembly_confirm_direct_approve: Approve and execute this proposal directly without a vote?
assembly_convocation_rule1: When an ordinary assembly closes, the next one is scheduled automatically
assembly_convocation_rule2: If the date of an ordinary assembly is modified, it remains ordinary
assembly_convocation_rule3: If a new assembly is created in addition to the ordinary one, it is extraordinary
assembly_convocation_rule4: Members receive notification with the configured advance notice
assembly_council_desc: A committee is a group of people with specialized knowledge in an area. For example, a
assembly_council_help: Select which committee or department will be responsible for approving this proposal type. Committees are created in the Departments section. Only committee members can vote.
assembly_date_1h: The date must be at least 1 hour from now.
assembly_date_24h: The date must be at least 24 hours from now.
assembly_date_7d: The date must be at least 7 days from now.
assembly_depts_assembly_desc: Assembly departments. The Assembly does not appear on the Organizations page, so its departments are managed here.
assembly_depts_orgs_desc: Departments of other organizations. Click an organization to expand its departments.
assembly_description_help: Descriptive text explaining what this proposal type does. Appears below the title to help understand what it is about.
assembly_help_assembly: Assembly: All voting members vote. It is the most democratic but slowest method. Ideal for serious decisions like changing taxes or expelling members.
assembly_help_authorized_any: Any of the authorized: Several people are authorized but ANY of them can approve alone. They do not all need to sign. Ideal when you want to delegate to several people but one acting is enough.
assembly_help_board: Board of Directors: Only board members vote. Faster than the assembly. Ideal for day-to-day administrative decisions like approving products.
assembly_help_council: Committee/Department: A specific committee or department decides. Ideal for technical decisions requiring specialized knowledge. Select which committee below.
assembly_help_multisig: Multi-signature: Several specific people or organizations must ALL sign. It is approved only when the required number of signatures is reached. Different from
assembly_help_organization: Organization: Delegates approval to an organization (cooperative, committee). The organization will have its own internal settings to decide who signs for it.
assembly_help_person: Specific person: A single authorized person approves. It is the fastest method. Ideal for routine decisions. Select who the person is below.
assembly_levels_desc: Member levels define whether they have voice, vote, and whether they count toward quorum. Each level has its own credit/debit limits and tax rate.
assembly_max_reschedules_hint: How many times it can be rescheduled
assembly_method_advice_desc: For routine matters (approve/disapprove products) use Board of Directors or Specific person. For serious matters (remove products, expel members, change taxes) use Assembly with a high threshold (66.67% or more).
assembly_method_advice_title: Advice on which method to use:
assembly_method_assembly_desc: All voting members vote in favor or against. It is approved if the percentage of votes in favor exceeds the threshold. E.g.: 50% = simple majority, 66.67% = 2/3, 75% = 3/4, 100% = unanimity.
assembly_method_authorized_any_desc: Several people are authorized but ANY of them can approve alone. They do not all need to sign. Different from multi-signature where all must sign.
assembly_method_board_desc: Only node board members vote. Faster than the full Assembly. Ideal for day-to-day administrative decisions.
assembly_method_council_desc: A specific committee or department decides. Select which committee. Committees are created in the Departments section. Ideal for technical decisions requiring specialized knowledge.
assembly_method_multisig_desc: Several specific people or organizations must ALL sign. It is approved only when the required number of signatures is reached. Select exactly WHO can sign (people and/or organizations).
assembly_method_organization_desc: Delegates approval to an organization (cooperative, committee, etc). The organization will have its own internal settings to decide who signs for it.
assembly_method_person_desc: A single authorized person approves. Useful for routine decisions that do not require debate. Select who the authorized person is.
assembly_min_amount_desc: Transactions below this amount pay no tax
assembly_minuta_empty_desc: No minutes written yet. Use the write button to create them.
assembly_minuta_read_desc: Minutes in read mode. Use the edit button to modify.
assembly_minutes_ph:
E.g.:

Assembly of March 15, 2024

1. Approved by majority to change the credit limit to 1000 TQ
2. Rejected the proposal to raise the tax to 3%
3. Admitted Maria Rodriguez as a new member
4. Pending: review the community fund budget
assembly_multisig_note: Permissions marked as [multisig] require Assembly voting. Assigning them directly grants them without a vote (requires config.manage permission).
assembly_no_authorized_persons: You have not added any authorized person. Add at least one.
assembly_no_councils: No committees/departments created. Create one in the Departments section first.
assembly_no_depts: There are no departments in this category.
assembly_no_members_cat: There are no members in this category.
assembly_no_org_depts: There are no departments from other organizations.
assembly_no_signers: You have not added any authorized signer. Add at least one.
assembly_not_yet_open: This assembly has not arrived yet. Attendance registration will open
assembly_only_existing_members: You can only assign existing node members.
assembly_org_help: Select the organization to which approval will be delegated. The organization will have its own settings to decide internally who signs for it.
assembly_org_internal_note: The organization will have its own internal settings to decide who can sign for it. This is configured within the organization.
assembly_org_percentage_help: Percentage of votes in favor within the organization for the approval to be valid.
assembly_orgs_desc: The node's organizations. They can also have assigned permissions. Assembly organizations (is_assembly_owned) belong directly to the node.
assembly_pending_review_desc: These proposals were created but the Secretary or authorized person has not yet approved them to be included in the minutes and open voting.
assembly_percentage_help: Percentage of votes in favor needed to approve. 50% = simple majority (more than half). 66.67% = two thirds. 75% = three quarters. 100% = unanimity (everyone must agree).
assembly_person_method_desc: This person will be able to approve or reject proposals of this type alone. It is the fastest method but concentrates power in one person. Use it only for low-risk routine decisions.
assembly_presential_desc: Only members present on the attendance list can vote
assembly_presential_note: If in-person, after creating the session you must take the attendance list. Members not on the list will not be able to vote in this assembly.
assembly_presential_voting_desc: Voting during the in-person assembly. When time expires, votes are counted.
assembly_proposal_desc_hint: Clearly explain the decision being put to a vote. Members will use this text to decide their vote.
assembly_proposal_desc_ph: Explain the proposal so members can vote informed
assembly_quorum_desc2: is the minimum number of members who must vote for the decision to be valid. If it is 0, there is no minimum.
assembly_quorum_first_call_desc: percentage required on the original date.
assembly_quorum_grace_desc: hours to wait after the start time before declaring the assembly invalid.
assembly_quorum_help_desc: Quorum is the minimum percentage of voting members who must be present for the assembly to be valid.
assembly_quorum_max_recall_desc: how many times the same assembly can be rescheduled.
assembly_quorum_no_quorum_desc: If quorum is not reached after the grace period, the assembly can be rescheduled (if allowed) or cancelled.
assembly_quorum_second_call_desc: reduced percentage if rescheduled (e.g.: 50% first call, 30% second call).
assembly_quorum_voters_help: Minimum number of members who must vote for the decision to be valid. If set to 0, there is no minimum and a single person's vote is enough. If set to 10, at least 10 members must vote.
assembly_quorum_voters_hint: Minimum members who must vote. 0 = no minimum.
assembly_remote_voting_desc: Remote voting: members can vote from anywhere. When time expires, the proposal is rejected if there is no quorum.
assembly_reschedule_desc: The assembly did not reach quorum on call
assembly_reschedule_desc4: The attendance list resets: members must confirm their presence again.
assembly_search_votes: Search votes by date, type or result
assembly_secret_vote_note: The vote is secret. This report shows counts and times, not who voted.
assembly_signatures_help: Number of signatures needed to approve. If you set 3, 3 signatures from the authorized people/organizations below are needed. It cannot be greater than the number of authorized signers.
assembly_signatures_hint: How many signatures are needed from the authorized people/organizations. All must sign.
assembly_signers_help: List of people and/or organizations with authority to sign. Only people/organizations on this list can sign. Add or remove with the buttons.
assembly_super_admin_desc: This user is an enabled Super Admin: they have ALL permissions automatically.
assembly_tax_account_desc: Taxes automatically go to this account. It is the same account as the General Assembly and the Community Fund. To spend this money, create a proposal of
assembly_tax_account_not_found: The Assembly account was not found. Taxes are sent to the General Assembly account (@asamblea). If it does not appear, verify that the General Assembly exists in the system.
assembly_tax_admin_desc1: The administrator can change the global tax rate directly during initial system setup. Once the assembly is running, changes are made by vote. Per-member-level rates are changed with proposals of
assembly_tax_admin_desc2: To distribute the collected funds, create a proposal of
assembly_tax_default_desc: Applied if the member's level has no rate of its own
assembly_tax_per_level_note: Each member level has its own rate. To change a rate, create a proposal of
assembly_taxes_calc_desc: Each member level has its own tax rate. When a member makes a transaction, their level's rate is applied. For example, a member
assembly_taxes_change_desc: Changes are made by Assembly vote. Create a proposal of type
assembly_taxes_change_desc3: indicating the member level and the new rate. The Assembly decides according to its approval configuration (full assembly vote, board of directors, or designated person).
assembly_taxes_how_desc: Taxes on transactions automatically go to the
assembly_taxes_no_separate: There is no separate tax account: the Assembly receives the taxes and manages the Community Fund. It is a single account with three names:
assembly_taxes_use_desc: To distribute the funds, create a proposal of
assembly_taxes_use_desc2: indicating the destination account (organization, department, manager or project) and the amount.
assembly_taxes_use_title: How to use the collected money:
assembly_urgent_desc: Urgent = quick decision. Minimum 1 hour notice.
assembly_voice_desc: All members with voice in the assembly. Includes those with vote and those with voice only (no vote).
assembly_voice_vote_desc: Members with voice and vote in the assembly. They can participate in debates and vote on decisions.
assembly_vote_timeline: Vote timeline (order of casting, secret vote)
assembly_voting_expired: Voting time expired. Create a new proposal to vote again.
create_proposal_hint: Create a proposal for the assembly to review.
create_session_hint: Create a session to discuss proposals.
fund_aliases_note: The 3 names are aliases of the same account. You can use any to transfer.
fund_info_1: The Community Fund IS the General Assembly account. They are not separate accounts: it is a single account that receives taxes and serves as the community treasury.
fund_info_distribute_desc: To spend money from the fund, create a "Fund distribution" proposal in the Proposals tab. Members vote and, if approved, the transfer is executed.
fund_info_transfer_desc: You can transfer to this account using any of these 3 names: @assembly, @taxes or @fondo_comunitario.

governance.title: Governance - Village Law
governance.subtitle: Coexistence rules, government structure, duties, prohibitions and processes
governance.help_what: Here the coexistence rules of the village are defined: the "Village Law".
governance.help_purpose_1: Define how the village is governed (structure, assembly, circles)
governance.help_purpose_3: Define what is permitted and prohibited
governance.help_purpose_4: Establish offenses, sanctions and causes for expulsion
governance.help_purpose_5: Document the admission and exit process
governance.help_who_1: The public page /p/gobernanza shows these rules to everyone
governance.help_who_2: The admission form shows the rules before accepting
governance.help_who_3: Members can consult them at any time
governance.help_edit: You can add, edit or delete rules. Rules are grouped by category and ordered by the order number.
governance.success_proposal: Go to Assembly to see the proposal and vote.
governance.important_notice: Important: Any change to the governance rules (create, modify or delete) requires approval from the General Assembly. When making a change, a proposal is created that must be voted on and approved. The rule will not be activated until the assembly approves it.
governance.success_delete: Deletion proposal sent to the assembly
governance.confirm_delete: Delete this rule? A proposal will be created for the assembly to approve.

help_members: Them members of it assembly are them same members of it community that have derecho a vote (segun its level). No itself registran aparte.
help_proposals: Decisions that itself someten a votacion. Each member with vote can vote a favor, in against or abstenerse.

help_taxes: It assembly decides it rate of tax on transactions. The money recaudado goes a a account of taxes.

proposal_help.limit_change: Changes the credit/debit limits of a user or node. E.g.: increase a member's credit limit from 100 to 300.
proposal_help.admission: Admits a new member by assigning a level. E.g.: admit "juan" with "full" level.
proposal_help.expulsion: Expels a member for misconduct. Requires high quorum. E.g.: expel "pedro" for fraud.
proposal_help.budget_increase: Increases the budget of an organization. E.g.: increase 500 to "coop_norte"'s budget.
proposal_help.federation_config: Changes federation limits or configuration with another node. E.g.: set credit limit with "node-b.org" to 1000.
proposal_help.recovery_config: Changes account recovery parameters. E.g.: change approval mode to multi_sig with 3 approvals.
proposal_help.tax_change: Changes the tax rate on transactions. The money goes to the tax account. Can be applied to a member or organization level. E.g.: 2% for "full" level.
proposal_help.member_level: Creates or modifies a member level with its permissions and limits. E.g.: create "full" level with limit 500.
proposal_help.policy: Any general policy decision of the community. E.g.: approve the internal regulations.
proposal_help.create_account: Creates a new accounting account in the node (not a user). Used to separate funds by purpose: social_fund, petty_cash, inventory, etc. The account is created with balance 0; to assign balance, a transfer approved by the Assembly is required.
proposal_help.fund_distribution: Distributes funds from one account/organization to another. E.g.: transfer 200 from "coop_norte" for service payment.
proposal_help.energy_rate_change: Changes an energy rate parameter. E.g.: change the price per kWh to 0.15.
proposal_help.product_modification: Modifies the price or data of an existing product. E.g.: change the price of "whole_bread" to 5.
proposal_help.product_approval: Approves a product to appear in the node catalog. By default decided by the Board.
proposal_help.product_disapproval: Disapproves a product (does not delete it, only changes its status). By default decided by the Board.
proposal_help.product_remove: Permanently removes a product from the catalog. Requires 2/3 of the Assembly by default.
proposal_help.product_import: Imports a product from another federated node to the local catalog. Requires simple majority.
proposal_help.product_to_base: Converts a composite product into a base product/raw material.
proposal_help.free_proposal: Free proposal on any topic not covered by the other types. E.g.: create a welcome committee.

scoped.board_desc: This is the Board of Directors of {{name}}. Operational decisions are made here: activity coordination, minor expenses, task assignment.
scoped.board_desc_hint: Only board members can vote. Decisions requiring approval from all members must go to the Assembly.
scoped.assembly_owned_desc: This organization belongs to the Assembly. Its decisions are discussed and voted on in the General Assembly of the node, where all members participate.
scoped.assembly_owned_hint: The board can make operational decisions that do not require Assembly approval.
scoped.internal_assembly_desc: This is the internal assembly of {{name}}. Decisions specific to {{label}} are made here: free proposals, voting, minutes and meetings.
scoped.internal_assembly_hint: Decisions from this assembly are independent from the node's general assembly.
